name: HeyReach
description: HeyReach LinkedIn outreach from any AI agent: campaigns and their leads, lead lists, the unified LinkedIn inbox, sender accounts, lead tags, network checks, outreach statistics and webhooks. Public API with an X-API-KEY key.
instructions:
## HeyReach
This connector uses the HeyReach public API (`https://api.heyreach.io/api/public`) for LinkedIn outreach: campaigns and their leads, lead and company lists, the unified LinkedIn inbox, sender accounts, lead tags, network checks, statistics and webhooks.

**Setup**
1. In HeyReach open **Integrations** and the **HeyReach API** section.
2. Click **Get API Key**, then **New API Key**, and copy the key into `HEYREACH_API_KEY`. Keys do not expire but can be deleted or deactivated there. A key belongs to one workspace.

The key is sent in the `X-API-KEY` header. `heyreach_check_api_key` returns 200 (empty body) when it works.

**Ids**
- `campaign_id` from `heyreach_list_campaigns`; sender ids (`account_id`, `linkedin_account_id`, `sender_id`) from `heyreach_list_linkedin_accounts`; `list_id` from `heyreach_list_lists`; `conversation_id` from `heyreach_list_conversations`; `webhook_id` from `heyreach_list_webhooks`.
- A lead is identified by its LinkedIn profile URL (`https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>/`) or its LinkedIn id (`linkedin_id` in lead records).

**Campaigns**
- Read: `heyreach_list_campaigns` (filter by status or sender), `heyreach_get_campaign`, `heyreach_get_campaign_sequence`, `heyreach_list_campaign_leads`, `heyreach_get_campaigns_for_lead`.
- Control: `heyreach_start_campaign` (draft to running), `heyreach_pause_campaign`, `heyreach_resume_campaign`.
- Leads: `heyreach_add_leads_to_campaign` (up to 100 per call, optional sender per lead), `heyreach_stop_lead_in_campaign`, `heyreach_update_lead_custom_fields`.
- Campaign statuses: DRAFT, IN_PROGRESS, PAUSED, FINISHED, CANCELED, FAILED, STARTING, SCHEDULED. Lead statuses: Pending, InSequence, Finished, Paused, Failed, Excluded.

**Lists**: `heyreach_list_lists`, `heyreach_get_list`, `heyreach_list_list_leads` (up to 1000 per page), `heyreach_list_list_companies`, `heyreach_get_lists_for_lead`, `heyreach_create_list`, `heyreach_add_leads_to_list`, `heyreach_delete_leads_from_list`. Adding leads to a list does not start them in a finished campaign; use `heyreach_add_leads_to_campaign` for that.

**Leads and tags**: `heyreach_get_lead` (profile details by URL), `heyreach_get_lead_tags`, `heyreach_add_lead_tags`, `heyreach_replace_lead_tags`.

**Inbox**
- `heyreach_list_conversations` lists conversations (cursor paging: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null). It does not return email addresses or custom fields; use `heyreach_get_lead` for those.
- `heyreach_get_conversation` returns the messages; `heyreach_send_message` replies from the sender that owns the conversation; `heyreach_set_conversation_seen` marks it read or unread.

**Senders and network**: `heyreach_list_linkedin_accounts`, `heyreach_get_linkedin_account`, `heyreach_get_linkedin_account_status` (is the LinkedIn session still valid), `heyreach_list_network` (1st-degree connections), `heyreach_is_connection`.

**Statistics**: `heyreach_get_overall_stats` and `heyreach_get_stats_by_campaign` take `start_date` and `end_date` (ISO 8601) and optional sender and campaign ids. `byDayStats` is keyed by day (UTC); rates are fractions (0.23 = 23%).

**Webhooks**: `heyreach_list_webhooks`, `heyreach_get_webhook`, `heyreach_create_webhook`, `heyreach_update_webhook`, `heyreach_delete_webhook`. One event type per webhook: CONNECTION_REQUEST_SENT, CONNECTION_REQUEST_ACCEPTED, MESSAGE_SENT, MESSAGE_REPLY_RECEIVED, EVERY_MESSAGE_REPLY_RECEIVED, INMAIL_SENT, INMAIL_REPLY_RECEIVED, FOLLOW_SENT, LIKED_POST, VIEWED_PROFILE, CAMPAIGN_COMPLETED, LEAD_TAG_UPDATED.

**Paging**: most lists take `offset` and `limit` (at most 100) and return `totalCount` and `items`. Times are ISO 8601, in UTC unless an offset is given.

**Limits and errors**: 300 requests per minute per key (429 above that). 401 means a wrong or deactivated key; 404 a wrong id; 400 an invalid body, for example a custom field name with characters other than letters, digits and underscores.

Creating campaigns, connecting LinkedIn accounts (passwords, cookies, proxies) and organization management are left out on purpose; do those in the HeyReach app.


**Switched off at install**: `heyreach_delete_leads_from_list` and `heyreach_delete_webhook`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

HEYREACH_API_KEY.label: API key
HEYREACH_API_KEY.help: HeyReach: Integrations, HeyReach API, Get API Key, New API Key. The key belongs to one workspace.
HEYREACH_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: HeyReach refused the API key. Create a new one under Integrations, HeyReach API, or check that it was not deactivated.
verifyHints.rate_limited: HeyReach allows 300 requests per minute. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: heyreach_check_api_key
tools.description: Check that the HeyReach API key works. Returns HTTP 200 with no body when it does.

tools.name: heyreach_list_campaigns
tools.description: List LinkedIn outreach campaigns with status, lead list, sender accounts and progress counts (total, in progress, pending, finished, failed). Up to 100 per page.

statuses.description: Status filter: DRAFT, IN_PROGRESS, PAUSED, FINISHED, CANCELED, FAILED, STARTING, SCHEDULED.

account_ids.description: Only campaigns using these LinkedIn sender ids (heyreach_list_linkedin_accounts).

tools.name: heyreach_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign: status, lead list, sender accounts, exclusion settings and progress counts.

tools.name: heyreach_get_campaign_sequence
tools.description: Get the sequence of a campaign: the tree of steps (connection request, message, InMail, follow, like, view profile) with delays and message texts.

tools.name: heyreach_list_campaign_leads
tools.description: List the leads of a campaign with their LinkedIn profile, status and last action. Shows the leads the campaign has picked up; more pending leads of the list may be inserted later.

time_from.description: Start of the time window, ISO 8601 with offset.

time_to.description: End of the time window, ISO 8601 with offset.

tools.name: heyreach_get_campaigns_for_lead
tools.description: List the campaigns a lead is in, with campaign status and the lead status in each (Pending, InSequence, Finished, Paused, Failed, Excluded). Identify the lead by email, LinkedIn id or profile URL.

linkedin_id.description: LinkedIn id of the lead (the linkedin_id field of lead records).

tools.name: heyreach_add_leads_to_campaign
tools.description: Add up to 100 leads to a campaign, optionally pinning each lead to a sender account. Returns how many leads were added, updated and failed. A paused campaign can be resumed by the same call.

account_lead_pairs.description: Pairs: [{"linkedInAccountId": 123 (optional sender), "lead": {"profileUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe", "firstName": "Jane", "lastName": "Doe", "companyName": "Acme", "position": "CTO", "emailAddress": "jane@acme.com", "customUserFields": [{"name": "pain_point", "value": "hiring"}]}}]. Custom field names: letters, digits and underscores only.

resume_paused_campaign.description: Resume the campaign if it is paused.

resume_finished_campaign.description: Restart the campaign if it has finished.

tools.name: heyreach_stop_lead_in_campaign
tools.description: Stop a lead in a campaign: it gets no further steps. Identify it by its LinkedIn member id or profile URL.

lead_member_id.description: LinkedIn member id of the lead (linkedin_id in heyreach_list_campaign_leads).

lead_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the lead.

tools.name: heyreach_pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign. No further actions are taken until it is resumed.

tools.name: heyreach_resume_campaign
tools.description: Resume a paused campaign so it continues its sequence where each lead stopped.

tools.name: heyreach_start_campaign
tools.description: Start a draft campaign. It needs a sequence, a lead list and at least one connected LinkedIn sender.

tools.name: heyreach_update_lead_custom_fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on a lead in a campaign, for use as variables in its messages.

lead_member_id_or_url.description: LinkedIn member id or profile URL of the lead.

tools.name: heyreach_list_conversations
tools.description: List LinkedIn conversations of the sender accounts, newest first, with the last message, read state and the lead profile. Cursor paged; filters by sender, campaign, lead, tags, read state and time.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

from.description: Only conversations with activity after this ISO 8601 time.

to.description: Only conversations with activity before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: heyreach_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one LinkedIn conversation with all its messages, senders and the lead profile.

account_id.description: LinkedIn sender id (linkedInAccountId of the conversation).

tools.name: heyreach_send_message
tools.description: Send a LinkedIn message in an existing conversation from the sender account of that conversation.

linkedin_account_id.description: Sender id that owns the conversation.

subject.description: Subject, only used for InMail conversations.

tools.name: heyreach_set_conversation_seen
tools.description: Mark a LinkedIn conversation as read or unread in the HeyReach inbox.

linkedin_account_id.description: Sender id that owns the conversation.

seen.description: true for read, false for unread.

tools.name: heyreach_list_linkedin_accounts
tools.description: List the LinkedIn sender accounts: name, email, active campaigns, whether the session is valid, Sales Navigator and Recruiter status, cooldowns and daily limits.

tools.name: heyreach_get_linkedin_account
tools.description: Get one LinkedIn sender account with its limits, cooldowns and session state.

tools.name: heyreach_get_linkedin_account_status
tools.description: Get the live connection status of a LinkedIn sender (Connected, Disconnected and why) and its Sales Navigator and Recruiter sessions.

tools.name: heyreach_list_lists
tools.description: List lead and company lists with their ids, sizes, type and the campaigns using them. Up to 100 per page.

campaign_ids.description: Only lists used by these campaigns.

tools.name: heyreach_get_list
tools.description: Get one lead or company list: name, type, size, creation time and campaigns using it.

tools.name: heyreach_list_list_leads
tools.description: List the leads of a lead list with profile, company, position, tags, email and custom fields. Up to 1000 per page.

keyword.description: Search by name or other fields.

created_from.description: Added on or after this ISO 8601 time.

created_to.description: Added on or before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: heyreach_list_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies of a company list with name, LinkedIn URL and details, paged.

tools.name: heyreach_get_lists_for_lead
tools.description: List the lead lists a lead belongs to. Identify the lead by email, LinkedIn id or profile URL.

linkedin_id.description: LinkedIn id of the lead (the linkedin_id field of lead records).

tools.name: heyreach_create_list
tools.description: Create an empty lead list or company list; fill it with heyreach_add_leads_to_list.

tools.name: heyreach_add_leads_to_list
tools.description: Add up to 100 leads to a lead list. Returns counts of added, updated and failed leads. A list is not a campaign: a finished campaign does not pick up new list leads; use heyreach_add_leads_to_campaign for that.

leads.description: Leads: [{"profileUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe", "firstName": "Jane", "lastName": "Doe", "companyName": "Acme", "position": "CTO", "emailAddress": "jane@acme.com", "location": "Berlin", "summary": "...", "about": "...", "customUserFields": [{"name": "pain_point", "value": "hiring"}]}]. profileUrl is required; custom field names may only contain letters, digits and underscores. At most 100 per call.

tools.name: heyreach_delete_leads_from_list
tools.description: Remove leads from a lead list by their LinkedIn profile URLs.

tools.name: heyreach_get_lead
tools.description: Get a lead by LinkedIn profile URL: name, headline, company, position, location, email, tags, experience and education.

tools.name: heyreach_get_lead_tags
tools.description: Get the tags of a lead, identified by its LinkedIn profile URL.

tools.name: heyreach_add_lead_tags
tools.description: Add tags to a lead (existing tags are kept). Identify the lead by profile URL or LinkedIn id.

lead_linkedin_id.description: LinkedIn id, instead of the URL.

create_tag_if_not_existing.description: Create tags that do not exist yet (otherwise unknown tags fail).

tools.name: heyreach_replace_lead_tags
tools.description: Replace all tags of a lead with the given ones. Identify the lead by profile URL or LinkedIn id.

lead_linkedin_id.description: LinkedIn id, instead of the URL.

create_tag_if_not_existing.description: Create tags that do not exist yet.

tools.name: heyreach_list_network
tools.description: List the 1st-degree LinkedIn connections of a sender account, paged.

tools.name: heyreach_is_connection
tools.description: Check whether a lead is a 1st-degree connection of a sender. Give the profile URL or the LinkedIn id, not both.

tools.name: heyreach_get_overall_stats
tools.description: Get outreach results for a period, per day and in total: profile views, likes, follows, connection requests sent and accepted, messages and InMails sent and replied, with acceptance and reply rates.

account_ids.description: Sender ids; [] or omitted for all.

campaign_ids.description: Campaign ids; [] or omitted for all.

tools.name: heyreach_get_stats_by_campaign
tools.description: Get the same outreach results as heyreach_get_overall_stats, broken down per campaign.

account_ids.description: Sender ids; [] or omitted for all.

campaign_ids.description: Campaign ids; [] or omitted for all.

tools.name: heyreach_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of the workspace with their URL, event type, campaigns and active state.

tools.name: heyreach_get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook with its URL, event type, campaigns and active state.

tools.name: heyreach_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that POSTs one event type to a URL, for all campaigns or selected ones.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the events.

event_type.description: Event: CONNECTION_REQUEST_SENT, CONNECTION_REQUEST_ACCEPTED, MESSAGE_SENT, MESSAGE_REPLY_RECEIVED, EVERY_MESSAGE_REPLY_RECEIVED, INMAIL_SENT, INMAIL_REPLY_RECEIVED, FOLLOW_SENT, LIKED_POST, VIEWED_PROFILE, CAMPAIGN_COMPLETED, LEAD_TAG_UPDATED.

tools.name: heyreach_update_webhook
tools.description: Change a webhook: name, URL, event type, campaigns, or switch it on or off. Only the fields passed are changed.

is_active.description: false to switch the webhook off.

tools.name: heyreach_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by id. Its URL stops receiving HeyReach events.
